description: This file defines the Startup model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to add, delete, update, and retrieve startup records from the database.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Model class for managing startup records in the database within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Creates a new startup record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by startup_id.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by its code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup record identified by startup_id.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by startup_id.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of startup records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total count of startup records in the database.
